in_sanskrit.name: देवुर्वंश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Those who are descended from God

in_marathi.name: Devurvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devurvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devurvansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Deva' (God) and 'Vansh' (lineage). This name signifies someone who is part of the divine lineage or descended from gods.
